rationale: Two canonical delivery SQL status updates were physically moved into fixed, authenticated private QA owner commands. Owner independently verifies the expiry timestamp or grant use limit and applies only a deny-first conditional update. Caller still denies already-expired or exhausted bearer tokens if private status maintenance cannot be contacted. Seven remaining delivery SQL identities are source-identical and re-fingerprinted. No new positive entitlement or delivery token is issued; production legal authority remains locked. This integration builds on the independently retired entitlement-device writer family and promotion owner family; combined current source inventory is 25, not 27.

files.review: Two negative token-status writes relocated privately after the independent entitlement-device migrations; five remaining delivery mutation sites are unchanged and re-fingerprinted.
